credentials_policy: Anonymous public HTTP only. Authentication denial, rate limiting, truncation, index limitations, and service failure are recorded as access failures and never converted into negative search results.

immutable_ref_rules.repo_local: Bind results to the base commit and tree; do not inspect another target as proof credit.
immutable_ref_rules.mathlib: Bind pinned results to lake-manifest revision and Git tree. Locally stored non-pinned refs are discovery-only until resolved to a commit/tree/source hash. Do not update, fetch, clone, checkout, build, or edit dependencies.
immutable_ref_rules.external: A source candidate receives formal-anchor credit only after a public hit is resolved to a 40-hex commit and its module/declaration/source blob, toolchain, dependency pins, license, and proof boundary are inspected at that commit.
immutable_ref_rules.search_responses: Dated response hashes are bounded discovery evidence, not immutable proof evidence.
immutable_ref_rules.statement_collections: Statement-only declarations remain M3 and receive no proof-body credit.

expected_negative_evidence: For local searches record exact query families, scope, exit status, and a deterministic result digest. For public searches record completion or truncation state, repository and match counts where supplied, response SHA-256, and every access limitation. A bounded zero result does not prove internet-wide absence.
classification_policy: Normalize each candidate against the exact positive-degree, finite-nonempty, regular, unweighted simple-graph target and distinguish conclusion wrapper from terminal body. Exact accepted repo-local closure is M0-L/M0-W/M0-P; credible independently reproducible external kernel closure outside this dependency graph is M1; partial closure is M2; statement/interfaces only are M3; no usable artifact found is M4; and mismatch, placeholder, incompatible, failed, or unverifiable candidates are M5. E3 source anchors never become M1 or M0.
credit_boundary: This protocol governs bounded formal-candidate discovery and classification only. It cannot supply a Hoffman proof, H0, R0, an obligation registry, AUDIT-Z, master acceptance, or theorem completion.
